content.title: Building a design system your whole team can use
content.excerpt: A practical way to turn colours, type and spacing into tokens that designers and developers share.
content.content:
Every website starts consistent and slowly drifts. A new button here, a slightly different grey there. A design system stops the drift by giving everyone the same small set of decisions to build with.

Start with tokens, not components

Colours, font sizes, spacing and shadows come first. In Hi WPEssential they live in theme.json, so the Site Editor, patterns and Elementor all read the same values. Change the primary colour once and every button follows.

  • Keep the palette to 8–12 named colours.
  • Use a fluid type scale so headings shrink gracefully on phones.
  • Define spacing in steps (8, 12, 16, 24, 32…) and never use one-off values.

Name things by purpose

Call a colour surface or text-muted rather than light-grey. Purpose names survive a rebrand and make a dark version possible without touching a single page.

The best systems are boring to use. You stop thinking about the button and start thinking about the message.

Ayesha Khan, Design Lead

Once the tokens are settled, components almost design themselves. Your patterns become combinations of decisions you already made.

content.title: A launch checklist for small business websites
content.excerpt: Twelve checks we run before every client site goes live, from speed to search to the contact form.
content.content:
Launch day should be calm. Most surprises come from small things nobody owned, so we keep one list and tick every box before the domain points to the new site.

Content and search

  • Every page has a unique title and meta description.
  • Images have alt text that describes them.
  • The contact page lists a phone number, email and opening hours.
  • Old addresses redirect to their new pages.

Speed and stability

Test the home page on a mid-range phone over 4G. If it takes longer than three seconds to show the headline, compress the hero image and remove unused plugins.

After launch

Submit the sitemap to search engines, set up uptime monitoring and schedule a review two weeks later. Real visitors always find something the team missed.

content.title: Gutenberg or Elementor? Choosing the right builder
content.excerpt: Both builders are first-class in Hi WPEssential. Here is how to decide which one fits your project.
content.content:
Hi WPEssential ships every demo for both the block editor and Elementor, built from the same design tokens. The right choice depends on who edits the site after launch.

Choose Gutenberg when

  • You want the fastest pages with the fewest plugins.
  • Editors already know the WordPress block editor.
  • The site is content-heavy: articles, documentation, news.

Choose Elementor when

  • Your team is used to visual drag-and-drop editing.
  • You need advanced motion effects or popup builders.
  • You plan to reuse an existing library of Elementor templates.

We switched one client from Elementor to blocks and their mobile load time dropped by forty percent.

Daniel Reyes, Developer

Whichever you choose, the header, footer, colours and fonts stay identical, so you can even move between builders later without a redesign.

Who we are

{{site:name}} runs this website. This policy explains what personal data we collect when you visit it, buy our products and services or contact us, and how we use it.

What we collect

  • Details you give us: name, email, phone, billing and delivery address when you order or get in touch.
  • Order details: what you bought, when and how you paid. Card numbers are handled by our payment provider and never stored by us.
  • Usage data: pages visited, device and browser, collected through cookies (see our Cookie Policy).

How we use it

  • To process orders, deliver what you bought and send receipts.
  • To answer questions and give support.
  • To send news or offers, only if you opted in. Every email has an unsubscribe link.
  • To keep the site secure and improve it.

Sharing

We share data only with services that help us run the business — payment, hosting, email and delivery providers — and only what they need. We never sell your data.

How long we keep it

Order records are kept for as long as tax law requires. Other data is deleted when it is no longer needed or when you ask us to.

Your rights

You can ask to see, correct, export or delete your data, or object to how we use it. Email {{site:email}} and we will reply within 30 days.

Changes

If this policy changes we update the date at the top of the page.

About these terms

These terms apply when you use this website or buy our products and services from {{site:name}}. By placing an order you agree to them.

Orders and prices

Prices include the taxes shown at checkout. An order is confirmed when you receive our confirmation email. We may cancel an order if an item is unavailable or a price was shown in error, and refund you in full.

Payment

Payment is taken at checkout through our payment provider. Subscriptions renew automatically until you cancel them in your account.

Using the website

  • Do not misuse the site, try to break its security or copy its content for commercial use without permission.
  • Accounts are personal; keep your password safe.

Intellectual property

Text, images, logos and designs on this site belong to {{site:name}} or its licensors.

Liability

We do our best to keep the site accurate and available but cannot guarantee it is always error-free. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have by law as a consumer.

Contact

Questions about these terms: {{site:email}}.

Our promise

If something is not right with your order, tell us and we will put it right.

Returns and refunds

  • Physical items: return within 30 days in original condition for a full refund.
  • Digital products and subscriptions: full refund within 14 days of purchase if you are not happy.
  • Services and bookings: cancel up to 7 days before the start date for a full refund.

How to ask for a refund

Email {{site:email}} with your order number. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5–10 working days.

Exceptions

Personalised items, used gift cards and services already delivered cannot be refunded unless they were faulty.

What cookies are

Cookies are small files saved by your browser. They help the site work and tell us how it is used.

Cookies we use

  • Essential: keep you signed in, remember your cart and keep checkout secure. These cannot be turned off.
  • Preferences: remember choices such as language or dark mode.
  • Analytics: count visits and see which pages are useful, only with your consent.
  • Marketing: measure campaigns, only with your consent.

Your choices

You can accept or reject non-essential cookies in the cookie banner and change your choice at any time. You can also delete cookies in your browser settings.

Contact

Questions about cookies: {{site:email}}.
